Clarifies the Python setup the Codex MCP preflight needs.

- Updated version to 0.3.3.

- Version bump to 0.3.1 in skill metadata and documentation.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.

- Updated keyless utility tool list to include new keyless tools: simmer_browse_markets, simmer_get_leaderboard, and simmer_register_agent.
- Startup banner now prints the exact keyless tool count for your build.
- Documentation improvements for clarity around available tools and utility functions.
- Removed the deprecated skill-card.md file.
- Bumped version to 0.3.0.

Simmer MCP Setup 0.2.0 introduces a streamlined bootstrap process for integrating the Simmer MCP server with agent runtimes.

- Detects agent runtime and sets up the appropriate MCP configuration automatically.
- Installs `simmer-mcp` via npm and configures it for your environment, including required SIMMER_API_KEY setup.
- Explains integration flow for paper and live trading, including triple opt-in safety for real venues.
- Details new raw trade primitives exposed by MCP (v3.3.0), enabling direct market queries and trades.
- Lists available Simmer skill tools, including core, raw primitives, and Pro-only tools.
- Improved platform-specific installation guidance for Node.js and npm.  
- Optional Python setup instructions for advanced tool support (`preflight`).

Drop hardcoded tool counts from SKILL.md — bundled-skill catalog grows over time, so '~12 tools' / '~11 per-skill execution tools' went stale fast. Now points users at list_skills (live source of truth) and clawhub.ai/skills?q=simmer (live catalog). Bounded sets stay enumerated (3 utility tools, 4 Pro autoresearch tools).

Fix frontmatter description framing — was misleadingly implying MCP is a swap-in for the Python SDK, now correctly describes MCP as the path for running pre-built Simmer trading strategies. Body and behavior unchanged from 0.1.0.

Initial release. One-shot bootstrap for the Simmer MCP server — API key check, Node.js detection, npm install, runtime-detect config wiring (Claude Code / Cursor / OpenClaw / Hermes / Codex), restart prompt, verify protocol. Closes the MCP onboarding dead-end on simmer.markets/start.
